meta.title: Version control panel
meta.description: Adds a version control tab to the right Sidebar for Git and Jujutsu repositories: working changes with file diffs, plus commit history with a lane graph and commit details. Browsing is read-only apart from branch actions and Sync: the branch menu checks out, renames, deletes, merges, rebases, and pushes local branches, and Sync fetches a Git branch’s upstream, then fast-forwards or pushes. A conflicting merge or rebase is aborted. It never stages, commits, force-pushes, discards changes, creates branches, or rewrites commits or bookmarks. Jujutsu may snapshot the working copy while reading.
